Each link below was checked this session and loads.

- **[21 CFR 606.20 — Cornell Legal Information Institute](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/606.20)**
  — the Personnel section behind this module's "documented competence" point, paragraph (b)'s
  "thorough understanding of the procedures or control operations they perform" standard, reused
  from `qa-deliverables-and-ownership`. Local verbatim copy: `sources/cfr/606.20.md`.

- **[AABB: Updated Quality Systems Essentials](https://www.aabb.org/standards-accreditation/standards/about-aabb-standards/updated-quality-systems-essentials)**
  — AABB's current landing page on the QSE (Quality System Essentials) structure, including
  Organization (QSE 1), the theme behind management review's own existence, and Resources (QSE 2),
  the theme behind tracking competence as a formal record. See
  `sources/aabb/qse-framework.md` for what's confirmed and what still needs re-checking before
  citing a specific edition.

- **[GovInfo: Code of Federal Regulations](https://www.govinfo.gov/app/collection/cfr)**
  — the government's own dated, authenticated CFR collection. Use this when a citation needs to
  be tied to a specific published edition rather than the current rolling text Cornell's LII
  shows.
